book.name: Saame
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI SAAME

content: Ki he Takimuʻa, ko e Saame pe ko e Hiva ʻa Tevita.

content.text: Ke tuʻu hake ʻae ʻOtua, tuku ke veteki hono ngaahi fili:
tuku ke puna foki mei hono ʻao ʻakinautolu ʻoku fehiʻa kiate ia.
Hangē ko e vilingia ʻo mole ʻae kohu,
ke pehē pe hono vilingia ʻakinautolu:
hangē ko e pulu ʻoku vela ʻo vai ʻi he afi,
ke ʻauha pehē pe ʻae kau angahala ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua.
Ka ʻe tuku ke fiefia ʻae māʻoniʻoni;
ke nekeneka ʻakinautolu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua:
ʻIo, ke fiefia lahi ʻaupito ʻakinautolu.
Hiva ki he ʻOtua, hiva fakamālō ki hono huafa:
fakaongoongolelei ia ʻoku hāʻele ʻi he ngaahi toafa
ʻi hono huafa ko SIHOVA,
pea fiefia ʻi hono ʻao.
Ko e tamai ʻae ʻOtua ki he tamai mate,
mo e fakamaau ia ʻi hono ʻafioʻanga māʻoniʻoni,
ki he kau fefine kuo mate honau husepāniti.
‌ʻOku ʻai ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae kau paea ʻi he ngaahi fale:
ʻoku ne ʻomi kituʻa ʻakinautolu kuo haʻi ʻaki ʻae ukamea fihifihi:
ka ʻoku nofo ʻae kau angatuʻu ʻi he fonua mōmoa.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻi hoʻo muʻomuʻa atu ki ho kakai,
ʻi hoʻo hāʻele ʻi he toafa; Sila.
Naʻe ngalulu ʻa māmani, pea ngangana mo e ngaahi langi foki ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua:
ʻio, naʻe ngaueue ʻa Sainai ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻOtua, ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, naʻa ke tuku hifo ʻae ʻuha lahi,
ʻaia naʻa ke fakamālohi ʻaki ho tofiʻa, ʻi heʻene vaivai.
Naʻe nofo ki ai ʻa ho kakai:
ʻE ʻOtua, kuo ke tokonaki ʻi hoʻo angalelei ki he masiva.
Naʻe foaki mai ʻe he ʻEiki ʻae folofola pea naʻe tokolahi ʻakinautolu naʻe fakahā ia.
“Naʻe hola vave ʻae ngaahi tuʻi ʻoe kautau:”
pea naʻe tufa ʻae vete ʻe he fefine naʻe nofo ʻo leʻo.
Neongo hoʻomou nofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe ngaahi kulo,
ka temou hangē ko e kapakau ʻoe lupe ʻoku ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ʻae siliva, mo hono fulufulu ko e koula melomelo.
‌ʻI he veteki ʻi ai ʻe he Māfimafi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi,
naʻe hinehina ia ʻo hangē ko e ʻuha hinehina ʻi Salimoni.
Ko e moʻunga ʻoe ʻOtua ʻoku hangē ko e moʻunga ko Pesani;
ko e moʻunga māʻolunga ʻo hangē ko e moʻunga ko Pesani,
Ko e hā ʻoku mou hopohopo ai, ʻakimoutolu ko e ngaahi moʻunga māʻolunga?
Ko e moʻunga eni ʻoku fili ʻe he ʻOtua ke nofo ki ai;
ʻio, ʻe nofo ki ai ʻa Sihova ʻo taʻengata.
Ko e ngaahi saliote ʻae ʻOtua ʻoku ua mano,
ʻio, ko e ngaahi toko afe ʻoe ʻāngelo:
ʻoku ʻiate kinautolu ʻae ʻEiki,
ʻio, ʻo hangē ko ʻene ʻi Sainai,
ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni.
Kuo ke hāʻele hake ki ʻolunga,
kuo u angatuʻu foki,
koeʻuhi ke nofo kiate kinautolu ʻa Sihova ko e ʻOtua.
Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki,
ʻaia ʻoku ne hili kiate kitautolu ʻae kavenga ʻoe meʻa lelei ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē,
ʻio, ko e ʻOtua ʻo hotau fakamoʻui. Sila.
Ko ia, ko hotau ʻOtua ko e ʻOtua ia ʻoe fakamoʻui;
pea ʻoku ʻia Sihova ko e ʻEiki ʻae moʻui mei he mate.
Ka ʻe taaʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae ʻulu ʻo hono ngaahi fili,
mo e tumuʻaki fulufulu ʻo ia ʻoku ʻalu pē ʻi heʻene ngaahi talangataʻa.
Naʻe pehē ʻe he ʻEiki, “Te u toe ʻomi mei Pesani,
te u toe ʻomi hoku kakai mei he loloto ʻo e ngaahi tahi.
Koeʻuhi ke kulokula ho vaʻe ʻi he toto ʻo ho ngaahi fili,
pea mo e ʻelelo ʻo hoʻo fanga kulī ʻi ai.”
Kuo nau mamata ki ho ngaahi hāʻeleʻanga, ʻE ʻOtua;
ʻio, ko e ngaahi hāʻeleʻanga ʻo hoku ʻOtua, mo hoku Tuʻi, ʻi he faletapu.
‌ʻOku muʻomuʻa ʻae kau hiva, pea hoko mo e kau pulotu tā mālie ʻoe ngaahi meʻa faiva;
pea ʻoku ʻiate kinautolu ʻae kau taʻahine ʻoku tā ʻae lali iiki.
“Mou fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻi he ngaahi fakataha,
ʻio, ki he ʻEiki, ʻakimoutolu mei he matavai ʻo ʻIsileli.”
‌ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa Penisimani siʻi mo honau pule,
ʻae houʻeiki ʻo Siuta mo ʻenau fakataha,
mo e houʻeiki ʻo Sepuloni, pea mo e houʻeiki ʻo Nafitali.
Ko ho ʻOtua kuo ne tuʻutuʻuni ho mālohi:
ke ke fakamālohi, ʻE ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻa ke fai kiate kimautolu.
Ko e meʻa ʻi ho faletapu ʻi Selūsalema,
ʻe ʻomi ai ʻe he ngaahi tuʻi ʻae ngaahi meʻaʻofa kiate koe.
Ke ke tautea ʻae fanga manu ʻoe vao kaho,
ʻae fuʻu tokolahi ʻoe fanga pulu tangata, mo e ngaahi ʻuhikiʻi pulu ʻoe kakai,
ke ʻoua kenau fakavaivai ʻakinautolu ʻaki ʻae ngaahi konga siliva:
ke ke veteki ʻae kakai ʻoku manako ki he tau.
‌ʻE haʻu ʻae ngaahi houʻeiki mei ʻIsipite;
ʻe mafao vave atu ʻae nima ʻo ʻItiopea ki he ʻOtua.
‌ʻAe ngaahi puleʻanga ʻo māmani,
mou hiva ki he ʻOtua;
hiva ʻaki ʻae fakamālō ki he ʻEiki: Sila.
Kiate ia ʻoku heka ki he langi ʻoe ngaahi langi, ʻaia naʻe ʻi muʻa pe;
vakai, ʻoku ne fakaongo atu hono leʻo, pea ko e leʻo māfimafi ia.
Mou tuku ki he ʻOtua ʻae mālohi:
ʻoku ʻi ʻolunga ʻi ʻIsileli ʻa hono nāunau,
mo ʻene māfimafi ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi langi.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku fakamanavahē ko e ʻituʻa ʻi ho ngaahi faletapu:
ko e ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli ko ia ʻoku ne foaki ʻae mālohi mo e faʻa fai ki hono kakai.
Fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua.
